title: Invertibility of the composition lift from the original derived-pullback counits
statement: Assume the shared module-sheaf derived-category instances [def-pc-derived-category] for every scheme, and let $Q_{h,X}$ be the localization from the homotopy category of module sheaves on $X$ to $D(\mathcal O_X)$. For each scheme arrow $p:X\to Y$, write $L_p=\operatorname{derivedPullback}(p)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] and retain its original universal presentation: the underived tensor functor $E_p$, its additivity, and the universal counit $\varepsilon_p:L_p\circ Q_{h,Y}\to Q_{h,X}\circ E_p$, invertible on $K$-flat complexes. The object and map equations of the presentation give $E_p=\operatorname{tensorPullback}(p)$; transport the counit and its properties along this equality. For scheme arrows $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$, form $\beta_{f,g}:L_f\circ L_g\circ Q_{h,Z}\to Q_{h,X}\circ E_f\circ E_g\to Q_{h,X}\circ E_{g\circ f}$ from the successive transported counits and the canonical underived tensor composition comparison, inserting functor associators. Define $c_{f,g}:L_f\circ L_g\to L_{g\circ f}$ as the universal left-derived lift of $\beta_{f,g}$ through $\varepsilon_{g\circ f}$. Then $c_{f,g}$ is invertible. The isomorphism recordedDerivedPullbackComposition is the asIso of this explicit lift.

proof.text: Project the original derived-pullback witness, retaining its underived functor, additivity, counit, universal property and K-flat equation as one structure. The object and morphism equations identify the underived functor with the fixed tensor formula. Transport the counit along that equality, and transport its universal and K-flat properties using equality induction.

proof.text: Construct the composite counit with functor associators, whiskering and the canonical underived tensor comparison. Define its derived map by leftDerivedLift. Apply isIso_derivedPullbackCompositionLift to the retained counits, their universal properties and their K-flat computation, and take asIso of the explicitly constructed lift.
